title: Meter aggregation and CLI
description:
Purpose: turn counted messages into the per-window vibe meter and expose it through a CLI.

Scope: aggregation over the window (thanks count, F-bomb count, message-level counts, per-source and per-session breakdown); ratio gauge (thanks divided by thanks plus F-bombs, quiet when no human messages) with configurable bands; scripts/sentiment-meter.ts wired as pnpm run sentiment:meter; flags --window (today, yesterday, last-24h, Nh, Nd, all), --since/--until, --day-start HH:MM (default local midnight), --timezone (IANA), --sources, --json, --cache-dir, --doctor; personal config file ~/.config/dataparade/sentiment.meter.yaml with precedence flags over config over defaults; Gherkin feature specs in features/ with steps driving the library directly (no Plexus host needed).

Done when: the meter renders counts-only output with the resolved window label (for example: today 04:00-04:00 America/Los_Angeles) for every window kind; --json emits the machine-readable report; output never contains message text; the Cucumber scenarios pass.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Epic complete: meter renders counts-only output with the resolved window label for every window kind, --json works, doctor works, Cucumber scenarios pass, config precedence holds.
